reports.title: Downward iterator yields an uninitialized tick when the start tick's compressed bit position is 255, and the hook writes reward growth to that tick
reports.evidence: Scenario tested: after the taxed swap from tick -1 (bit 255, tick spacing 1), a new position [-1, 50) has 0 pending rewards, before and after the price moves into it, the same as on the audited code and the reference repair. No effect shown. The repair does return an uninitialized tick at bit 255, which breaks requirement 4 without a shown security effect.

reports.title: Returning an uninitialized bit-255 tick can make valid zero-for-one swaps revert
reports.evidence: Scenario tested (repair_checks/UninitializedBit255Tick.t.sol): the taxed zero-for-one swap from tick -1 to -3 with tick spacing 1 does not revert on this repair, nor on the audited code, the human fix or the reference repair.
